statement: For ACTUAL smooth psi=-cosx+epsilon sin^6x cosy,ordinaryheat psi_t=Delta psi gives E=<det(Hesspsi)^2>=33epsilon^2/4096+1020357epsilon^4/524288 and Eprime=3epsilon^2/1024-11319399epsilon^4/131072. At epsilon=1/1000,Eprime=372680601/131072000000000000>0. Supplied exact eight-mode Fourier multiplication overQ uses no grid or floating derivative. Thus ordinary heat is not a universal monotone flow for polyconvex/QC det^2;no exact closed-form primitive can turn that density into pointwise nonnegative dissipation on ALL compatible jets. For every FIXED positive-definite constant diffusionD,spatial change y=D^-1/2x and normalized transformed periodic cell preserve positive sign up to positive determinant factor. Degenerate diffusion does not relax all modes,but nonlinear/nonlocal flows and nonmonotone variational representations are NOT excluded. det^2 remainsQC by determinant-null-Lagrangian/Jensen. This is a METHOD obstruction,not QC counterexample,capacity failure or admitted ROC/QC separation.
